figures.name: Perun

ability.name: Oak Lightning
ability.description: Strike all dark-alignment enemies for 5 damage; remove all dark buffs.

figures.description: Supreme thunder god who wields a golden axe and eternally battles Veles for cosmic supremacy.

figures.name: Veles

ability.name: Serpent Form
ability.description: Shapeshift: steal 3 HP from all enemies and add to own HP.

figures.description: Shape-shifting underworld god of cattle and magic who steals Perun's cattle and retreats underground.

figures.name: Baba Yaga

ability.name: Iron Mortar
ability.description: Fly to any position; reveal all hidden cards; the next question asked must be answered.

figures.description: Ancient forest witch who lives in a hut on chicken legs and either destroys or rewards those bold enough to seek her.

figures.name: Mokosh

ability.name: Spinner of Fate
ability.description: Choose one ally: guarantee their next action succeeds and deals maximum damage.

figures.description: Earth mother and spinner of fate who protects women and was the only goddess in the original Slavic pantheon.

figures.name: Svarog

ability.name: Sacred Forge
ability.description: Permanently upgrade one ally's stats by +2 power and +2 defense.

figures.description: Sky and forge god father of the sun who established laws of civilization and the institution of marriage.

figures.name: Rod

ability.name: Ancestral Blood
ability.description: Summon an ancestor spirit ally with identical stats to a fallen ally for 2 turns.

figures.description: Creator god and originator of all life whose cult links the living to all their ancestors.

figures.name: Koschei the Deathless

ability.name: Deathless Secret
ability.description: Cannot be destroyed until his hidden soul (needle in egg in duck in chest) ability is revealed and attacked.

figures.description: Undying evil sorcerer whose soul is hidden in a needle inside an egg inside a duck inside a chest on an island.

figures.name: Firebird

ability.name: Golden Feather
ability.description: Grant one ally a golden feather: +3 to all stats for 1 turn; the feather then passes to another ally.

figures.description: Magical bird of blazing fire whose feathers illuminate entire kingdoms and whose capture is every hero's quest.

figures.name: Marzanna

ability.name: Winter's Grip
ability.description: Slow all enemies' speed by 3 for 2 turns; deal 2 cold damage per turn.

figures.description: Death goddess of winter and plague effigy drowned each spring to end the cold season.

figures.name: Lada

ability.name: Spring Awakening
ability.description: Remove all cold/death debuffs; grant all allies +2 magic for 1 turn.

figures.description: Goddess of love and beauty who presides over spring, marriage and the flowering of the world.

figures.name: Stribog

ability.name: Wind Scatter
ability.description: Disperse all buffs on one enemy; redistribute them randomly across the field.

figures.description: God of winds who blows across the world to distribute messages and disperse the breath of life.

figures.name: Leshy

ability.name: Forest Maze
ability.description: Enemy must skip next turn while lost in the forest illusion.

figures.description: Wild forest spirit who leads travelers astray, mirrors their appearance and can expand or shrink at will.

figures.name: Rusalka

ability.name: Watery Embrace
ability.description: Charm one male enemy: they cannot attack this card and lose 2 stats.

figures.description: Beautiful and deadly water spirit of drowned women who drag men beneath the surface on moonlit nights.

figures.name: Zmey Gorynych

ability.name: Triple Fire Breath
ability.description: Deal 3 fire damage to three different enemies simultaneously.

figures.description: Three-headed fire-breathing dragon that regrows each head when cut off, terror of the Russian folktale.

figures.name: Poludnitsa

ability.name: Noon Interrogation
ability.description: Freeze one enemy and ask a riddle: if unanswered, that enemy loses 4 wisdom permanently.

figures.description: Lady Midday who appears as a dust whirlwind at noon and afflicts anyone who cannot answer her endless questions.

figures.name: Domovoi

ability.name: Hearth Guard
ability.description: Prevent the next debuff from affecting any ally; warn of incoming powerful attacks.

figures.description: Small hairy household spirit who lives behind the stove and protects the family if treated with respect.

figures.name: Vodyanoy

ability.name: Mill Drag
ability.description: Reduce one enemy's speed to 1 for 2 turns.

figures.description: Waterlogged old spirit who drowns swimmers and capsizes boats unless offered tobacco and bread.

figures.name: Ilya Muromets

ability.name: Cossack's Stand
ability.description: Take the next attack aimed at any ally; deal it back at double power.

figures.description: Legendary bogatyr hero who lay paralyzed for 33 years before rising to defend Holy Russia.

figures.name: Dobrynya Nikitich

ability.name: Courteous Warrior
ability.description: After defeating an enemy, restore 2 HP to all allies.

figures.description: Noble bogatyr hero famed as much for his diplomacy and courtly manners as for his skill against monsters.

figures.name: Kikimora

ability.name: Nightmare Web
ability.description: Target enemy loses 2 wisdom and cannot use wisdom-based abilities next turn.

figures.description: Malevolent household spirit that tangles spinning threads, causes nightmares and pinches sleeping people.
